description: Seed library of artifact configs for the auto-research loop. Each config = an artifact scene path + optional param overrides via apply_grid_config(). Schema mirrors substrate_research and mesh_grammar_research so all three galleries are queried by the same iteration tooling.

configs.notes: The reference marker artifact. Single dark sphere on a small base. Used everywhere as a placeholder.
Mosaic floor with basket-weave motif. From the pompeii_mosaic_floor family — procedural mosaic with palette + tile + grout parameters.
Compass-rose mosaic floor — radial taxonomy in tiles.
Diamond-lattice mosaic — orthogonal tessellation with diamond infill.
Persian rug procedural pattern — cellular automaton on a rug.
Recrystallization cellular automaton showcase. CA evolution as the artifact.
Random-walk crystal growth — 3D random-walker leaving a crystallised trace.
